query: INSERT INTO twitch_session_chatters (session_id, streamer_login, chatter_login, chatter_id, first_message_at, messages, is_first_time_streamer, seen_via_chatters_api, last_seen_at) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 0, $6, TRUE, $5) ON CONFLICT (session_id, chatter_login) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at
